Commits the rate × heads × hours split for a process path — the CommitShiftPlan use case. Enforces the `PathPlan` aggregate invariant `plannedHeads <= installedStations`; violating it fails the whole commit (no partial commit). This is THIS service's own `ShiftPlan` aggregate, distinct from the labor plan Workforce Management reports (see `GET /paths/{pathId}/labor-plan-view`) even though both are called "ShiftPlan" — classic same-term-different-bounded-context. Publishes `ShiftPlanCommitted`. The request may optionally name a `sku` and a `pickUnit` (`EACH` | `CASE`, default `EACH`) for a pack-aware plan (ADR-0045): the response then carries `handle`, the load of one handle of that SKU and the carry estimate derived from it.
